Container.Name: novacortex-qdrant
Container.Overview:
Qdrant preconfigured as the vector index for the NovaCortex stack — this is what makes semantic search over your agent's memory work. Qdrant itself is by Qdrant Solutions GmbH; this template is maintained by Nova Cognitive Systems, and support below goes to the NovaCortex issue tracker.
Part 3 of a 5-container stack. Install in this order, all on the same Docker network:
0. Create the shared network once, from an Unraid terminal: docker network create novacortex Container-name DNS only works on a user-defined network, which is how the API finds this container by the name "novacortex-qdrant". 1. novacortex-redis 2. novacortex-surrealdb 3. novacortex-qdrant (this template) 4. novacortex-api 5. novacortex-web
Optionally add novacortex-ollama before the API, to compute embeddings on this server instead of sending memory text to OpenAI.
Prefer one click to five? Install the whole stack with the Docker Compose Manager plugin instead — see templates/unraid/README.md in the project repository. Both paths are supported and produce the same container names.
Notes for this container: - It publishes no ports, matching the supported Compose stack. If you want the Qdrant dashboard on your LAN, add a port mapping for container port 6333 yourself and set an API key below first. - Vector dimension is decided by the API, not here. It has to match your embedding model (1536 for text-embedding-3-small, 768 for nomic-embed-text), and changing it later needs a fresh collection.
Container.Description:
Qdrant is an open-source vector database and similarity-search engine written in Rust. NovaCortex embeds memory text and stores the resulting vectors here, then queries Qdrant to answer natural-language searches; without it, search falls back to plain substring matching.
This template pins v1.14.0, the version the NovaCortex stack is tested against, and stores its index under /mnt/user/appdata/novacortex/qdrant.
Container.Requires: A user-defined Docker network named "novacortex" (docker network create novacortex). Only useful together with the rest of the NovaCortex stack.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: novacortex qdrant vector database embeddings semantic search mcp self-hosted agents

Config.Name: Storage Path
Config.Description: Where Qdrant keeps its vector index. Must be an absolute path on the array or a pool — never the boot flash.

Config.Name: API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty on a LAN-only stack where Qdrant publishes no ports. If you set it, put the same value in QDRANT_API_KEY on the novacortex-api template.

Config.Name: Storage Path (in container)
Config.Description: Must match the container side of the storage path above.

Config.Name: Enable TLS
Config.Description: Leave false. Traffic never leaves the internal Docker network, and the API connects over plain HTTP.
